name: AutoBridge Systems

name: CrowdGenAI

name: Global Interconnection Group (GIG)

name: Open Origin

name: Open Policy

name: SuperAlign
business_summary: Enterprise AI safety and governance tooling. Three products: Surface (endpoint AI asset scanner), Radar (network AI discovery/shadow AI detection), AIRiskDB (threat intelligence for AI tools and MCP servers).

name: RiskOpsAI

name: KELA Cyber
